import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Set seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate synthetic financial transaction data
num_records = 1000
data = {
    "transaction_id": range(1, num_records + 1),
    "transaction_amount": np.random.normal(loc=100, scale=20, size=num_records),
    "account_age": np.random.randint(1, 10, size=num_records),
    "transaction_type": np.random.choice(["purchase", "refund"], size=num_records),
}

# Introduce anomalies
data["transaction_amount"][np.random.choice(num_records, 10, replace=False)] *= 10

# Rename columns to obfuscate
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.rename(columns={
    "transaction_id": "id",
    "transaction_amount": "amount",
    "account_age": "age",
    "transaction_type": "type"
}, inplace=True)

# Inject a canary value
df.loc[0, "amount"] = 99999

# Save to CSV
df.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
